name: David Miller
psychographics: Prioritizes time savings over cost; values structured routines and predictability in family life.
current_solutions: HelloFresh subscription for weekday dinners; Instacart for grocery pickups; Amazon Subscribe & Save for household staples.
frustration: The Instacart driver arrived at 8:15 PM on a Tuesday, two hours after the promised 6 PM window, forcing him to feed the kids cold cereal at 9 PM before bed.
decision_style: Compares feature sets quickly; prefers subscription models that auto-renew to avoid re-evaluating options monthly.
voice: Efficient and direct; uses industry terms like "touchpoint" and "synergy" even in casual conversation about family logistics.
